recommended_c602_handoff.title: C602 — Close F-01 privileged-gateway bypass and prove the database authorization boundary
recommended_c602_handoff.reason: C600's only executable external-trust security control tests a NOLOGIN untrusted role without EXECUTE. The highest-risk gap is direct invocation through one of the privileged gateway actor credentials without a valid signed authorization envelope. This is narrower and prerequisite to F-02 through F-08 implementation.
scope: Obtain and attach original C599 report if available; otherwise explicitly retain the assigned F-01..F-08 list as the accepted review specification.
Catalog all nine privileged function signatures, owners, SECURITY DEFINER properties, grants, memberships and alternate invocation paths on disposable PostgreSQL 16.
Design and implement versioned v2 wrappers with DB-side signature/claim validation; revoke direct legacy RPC execution from every runtime actor role.
Create distinct approver, runner, observer, recovery and verifier roles with fail-closed session_user-to-principal mapping; include F-02 tests as prerequisite guardrails.

Test each of nine direct calls from anon/authenticated/application and every gateway actor login with absent, invalid, expired, replayed and mismatched envelope; assert full row hashes/counts and zero external dispatch side effects.
Run exact-head branch and PR CI, inspect PostgreSQL logs, preserve all 40 inherited migration blobs and C575/C576 contracts; do not modify Production.
recommended_c602_handoff.acceptance: Every legacy direct invocation denied; only a correctly signed, operation/resource/generation/actor-bound wrapper call succeeds exactly once; all negative tests have zero side effects; exact-head CI PASS; DBA and Security approve the disposable enforcement design.
recommended_c602_handoff.not_scope: Do not build or claim Production provider physical-clone protection; do not provision secrets, modify Production roles, or merge PR #36/#37.
